SELECT tier, is_current, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_from, MAX(valid_from) AS max_from, MIN(valid_to) AS min_to, MAX(valid_to) AS max_to, MAX(join_date) AS max_join
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS n_current, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') AS gold_current FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1
), asof AS (
  SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS n_valid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') AS gold_valid FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY 1
), allm AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_total, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE tier='Gold') AS ever_gold FROM dim_member)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur) AS members_with_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur WHERE n_current>1) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur WHERE gold_current>0) AS gold_current_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asof) AS members_valid_asof,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asof WHERE n_valid>1) AS multi_valid,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asof WHERE gold_valid>0) AS gold_valid_members,
 (SELECT members_total FROM allm) AS members_total,

 (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date,
